data.execution: Agent, Harness and the CAD package run in the same sandbox; Harness invokes local module actions

naming.persistence: feature_IR_names; not foreign STEP entity numbers

restrictions.curve_sweep: one line/arc/Bezier path; explicit profile at path start
restrictions.fillet_shell: kernel failures surfaced; optional explicit on_fail record preserves the input with a degradation receipt
restrictions.large_grid: 1024 holes supported; may require host wallMs=120000
restrictions.solvers: local branch and local Jacobian rank; not a proof of global uniqueness
restrictions.step_import: rigid product and mapped-item placements; shared definitions; mixed representation units and nonrigid mappings refused
restrictions.surface_bridge: Bezier U-end to U-start; matching V degree; analytic C2 jets; no global Class-A certification
